reasons.action: No visual reference or observed subject is supplied, so action authority rests with the request; no conflicting source performance or pose governs.
reasons.medium: No visual reference is supplied; the medium decision pins the rendering medium to the request, with no reference medium or treatment overriding it.
reasons.wardrobe: No visual reference or observed subject is supplied, so there is no source wardrobe to retain; wardrobe authority remains with the request.
reasons.lighting: No visual reference supplies an observed lighting setup, and the brief gives no lighting instruction; without a reference light to preserve, lighting is request-governed.
reasons.framing: No visual reference supplies an observed camera composition, and aspect ratio alone is not a camera-framing instruction; framing authority remains with the request.
reasons.palette: No visual reference supplies an observed color grade or tonal treatment, and photorealistic live-action is a medium intent rather than a palette instruction; palette is request-governed.
